Read the three steps
  1. Tell us about your home. Share your selling priorities, property details, and preferred timing through a few quick questions.
  2. Consider a cash offer. Miron reviews the property and discusses an offer if it’s a fit. Condition, location, and renovation needs inform the price. Review the costs and terms before deciding.
  3. Plan your next chapter. If you accept, agree on a closing date and work through the sale details. Timing depends on the property, title, and agreed terms.
